handbookNote: Batch 2 depth expansion for the Maryland notary track -- same grounding as the original md_notary track (Md. Code, State Government Article, Title 18 (Notaries Public) -- Subtitle 1 Appointment (SS18-101 to 18-105) and Subtitle 2 Uniform Law on Notarial Acts (SS18-201 to 18-223, effective for acts on/after October 1, 2020), together with implementing regulations at COMAR 01.02.08 (Notary Public General Regulations)) but adds scenario/application questions (same underlying rule, new concrete fact patterns), procedural and fee-calculation questions, statutory edge cases and exceptions, common notary error patterns, and cross-references between related provisions -- written to responsibly deepen the practice pool beyond the original 67-question batch 1 without reusing or lightly rewording its questions. Price matches this project's established $9.99 Notary tier, not a placeholder
